blocks.text: That question has been answered differently across traditions. Rather than a verdict, here is what two voices from different centuries said, with the passages they were reading.

blocks.quote: Wine was given to make us cheerful, not to make us behave ourselves unseemly
blocks.summary: Chrysostom treats wine as a good gift and drunkenness as its misuse, calling it a voluntary madness and a self-chosen slavery of the will.

blocks.quote: Drunkenness is a sin that rarely goes alone
blocks.summary: Henry calls drunkenness a sin against the body and contrasts being filled with wine against being filled with the Spirit.

blocks.text: You may want to bring this before God in prayer. Psalm 51 has been prayed over questions like this for three thousand years.
